auth_scope: roles/cloudasset.viewer granted at the organization scope (read-only; confers no access to the underlying resources)

pagination.exhaustion_method: pass pageToken from the previous response's nextPageToken until the response omits it; pageSize=500

rate_limits: cloudasset.googleapis.com search-API per-project quota; honor 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED with exponential backoff
history_caveats: STATE only: current IAM bindings cannot prove when access was removed - Admin Activity audit logs carry the change history
Principals with access outside IAM policy bindings (downloaded service-account keys, break-glass accounts provisioned out of band) do not appear in policy search
